summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Loundry Suci (fresh build). Backend: 27/27 pytest cases pass covering auth, catalog, order lifecycle (create with points redemption, pay, sequential admin status progression, courier tracking, feedback) plus authorization/edge cases (cross-customer 403, non-admin status 403, non-sequential status 400, feedback before selesai 400, insufficient points auto-ignored). Frontend (Expo web preview, mobile viewport 390x844): customer login -> home (points card, catalog grid) -> create order -> pay -> tracking timeline + stylized web map fallback ('map-tracker') all functioning. Admin login -> dashboard with counts (16 Aktif / 19 Total), filter chips (Aktif/Semua/Selesai), advance-status button progresses order status and refreshes list, completed orders show star rating. Found & fixed ONE real backend bug: courier endpoint threw TypeError when comparing naive Mongo datetime to tz-aware now_utc() (500 error whenever order is in 'siap'). Also added a conftest that resets demo customer points to 30 before test session to keep redemption tests deterministic.

rca_of_issue: Bug RCA: GET /api/orders/{id}/courier returned 500 whenever an order reached status 'siap'. Cause: MongoDB stores datetimes as UTC-naive; when the doc was read back, siap_at had tzinfo=None while now_utc() returns a tz-aware datetime — subtraction raised 'TypeError: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes'. Reproduction: create order -> pay -> admin PATCH status to dicuci->disetrika->siap -> GET /orders/{id}/courier -> 500. Fix (server.py:395): after loading siap_at, if siap.tzinfo is None assign timezone.utc. Verified: all 27 pytest cases now pass and end-to-end UI flow reaches tracking screen without red screen.
